question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Edward Jones is pursuing a new digital platform focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors, as one of its initiatives.
items.quote: These initiatives also include targeting new clients: High Net Worth, focused on attracting and serving high net worth clients through expanded advice, planning, products and services across multiple service models; Workplace, which connects local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace; and a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.

items.text: Edward Jones announced it has taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken, intending the investment as a step toward integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities into Edward Jones to support its value proposition and advisor conversations with clients.
items.quote: Edward Jones announced that they have taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken , with an explicit intention that the investment is a step towards integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities more directly into Edward Jones

items.text: Edward Jones offers Financial Planning Services as a recently launched product where clients receive a more personalized experience with additional planning capabilities.
items.quote: recently launched products and solutions such as Financial Planning Services, where clients receive a more personalized experience with additional planning capabilities

items.text: Edward Jones offers a variety of solutions including investment advisory programs, brokerage and retirement accounts, cash and lending solutions and financial planning offerings.
items.quote: The Partnership offers a variety of different solutions to clients, including investment advisory programs, brokerage and retirement accounts, cash and lending solutions and financial planning offerings.

items.text: Edward Jones offers Guided Solutions, a client-directed advisory program with Fund or Flex account options that may invest in mutual funds, ETFs, and (Flex) stocks, bonds and CDs.
items.quote: Guided Solutions is a client-directed advisory program where financial advisors work with clients to build a portfolio... Guided Solutions offers two options, a Fund account or Flex account... Both types of Guided Solutions accounts may invest in mutual funds... and ETFs. However, Guided Solutions Flex accounts may also invest in stocks, bonds and CDs.

items.text: In Canada, Edward Jones provides MyCompass discretionary investment advisory services and Guided Portfolios, a non-discretionary fee-based program.
items.quote: Through MyCompass, Canadian financial advisors provide discretionary investment advisory services to clients by using independent investment managers and proprietary asset allocation models. Guided Portfolios is a non-discretionary, fee-based program with structured investment guidelines available to Canadian investors.

items.text: Edward Jones offers trust services to U.S. clients through Edward Jones Trust Company, and offers money market and mutual funds via Olive Street Investment Advisers.
items.quote: Trust services are offered to Edward Jones' U.S. clients through Edward Jones Trust Company... Olive Street Investment Advisers, LLC... provides investment advisory services to the Edward Jones Money Market Fund... and the twelve sub-advised mutual funds comprising the Bridge Builder® Trust.

items.text: Edward Jones has partnered with Aboon and Retirement Plan Advisory Group to develop an end-to-end retirement plan management tool to help advisors serve business owners and their employees.
items.quote: Edward Jones has partnered with Aboon, an AI-driven third-party administrator, and Retirement Plan Advisory Group (part of Great Gray Group) to develop an end-to-end retirement plan management tool.

items.text: Edward Jones advertises a Workplace initiative that connects local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace.
items.quote: Workplace, which connects local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace

cells.reason: Multiple passages describe products, services, platforms and initiatives Edward Jones offers to attract and serve next-generation and other clients; none indicate non-disclosure, so these are facts.
